titleEn: Number of Pairs of Interchangeable Rectangles
title: 可互换矩形的组数
summary: 两个矩形宽高比相同则可互换，统计下标对数量。
insight: 用宽高最大公约数约分成唯一整数对作为键。遍历时已有同键矩形数就是当前新增配对数。
pitfalls: 比例需精确比较避免浮点误差

solutions.title: 约分宽高比频次
solutions.idea: 以互质宽高对作为比例的规范表示。

code.java: class Solution { private int gcd(int a,int b){while(b!=0){int remainder=a%b;a=b;b=remainder;}return a;}public long interchangeableRectangles(int[][] rectangles){Map<String,Integer> frequency=new HashMap<>();long answer=0;for(int[] rectangle:rectangles){int divisor=gcd(rectangle[0],rectangle[1]);String key=rectangle[0]/divisor+"/"+rectangle[1]/divisor;int count=frequency.getOrDefault(key,0);answer+=count;frequency.put(key,count+1);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun gcd(aValue:Int,bValue:Int):Int{var a=aValue;var b=bValue;while(b!=0){val remainder=a%b;a=b;b=remainder};return a};fun interchangeableRectangles(rectangles:Array<IntArray>):Long{val frequency=HashMap<String,Int>();var answer=0L;for(rectangle in rectangles){val divisor=gcd(rectangle[0],rectangle[1]);val key=(rectangle[0]/divisor).toString()+"/"+(rectangle[1]/divisor);val count=frequency[key]?:0;answer+=count;frequency[key]=count+1};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: long long interchangeableRectangles(vector<vector<int>>& rectangles){map<pair<int,int>,int> frequency;long long answer=0;for(auto& rectangle:rectangles){int divisor=gcd(rectangle[0],rectangle[1]);pair<int,int> key={rectangle[0]/divisor,rectangle[1]/divisor};answer+=frequency[key]++;}return answer;} };
